snippet.title: Chronicles of Albian 3: The Vanishing Village Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Gwendolyn the Fairy Godmother returns from vacation to find Albian Village has vanished into thin air! Only her old castle stands, now sheltering the displaced townsfolk. With rooms full of forgotten valuables, it’s up to you to help Gwendolyn search every chamber for useful items, solve tricky puzzles, and fund the powerful counterspells needed to restore the village in this charming hidden object adventure!

https://www.bigfishgames.com/

Available for Game Club Members on October 11th!

Wade into a wide collection of downloadable games for PC and Mac at Big Fish Games! Try before you dive with free trials on every title!
